question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Miserable
solution:
The correct answer is: **Cheerful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Miserable"** means feeling extremely unhappy or uncomfortable. (दुखी)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **miserable **after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **"Cheerful" **refers to being noticeably happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example: **He was always **cheerful**, even in difficult situations.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Miserable' **is **'Cheerful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Depressing** (उदास करने वाला): Making you feel very sad and without enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was so **depressing **that I didn't want to leave the house.
 
 
 
• **Decorated** (सजाया हुआ): Made to look more attractive by adding items or designs.
 
 
• **Example: **The room was beautifully **decorated **for the wedding.
 
 
 
• **Wealthy** (धनी): Having a lot of money, possessions, or resources.
 
 
• **Example:** He is one of the most **wealthy **businessmen in the city.
